supersededReadings.reason: The replay sampler reserved no fallback QUOTA, so on a wave with many fallback parents they consumed the whole cap and 0 shed lod_1 assets were covered. `cellsSampled` counted cells PICKED rather than cells that contributed, which hid a third defect of the same family: with no per-cell cap the entire sample came from the FIRST cell, against this CLI's own promise of a sample spread across ownership cells. `fallbackAvailability` additionally asserted the sample included a fallback without checking. This entry preserves the reading those defects produced; it is NOT retracted, it is superseded.
